data.name: Barista (Frontend)
data.description: This logs into the staff interface, views incoming orders, selects an order, and changes its status.

threats.title: Customer Account Spoofing
threats.description: T-001: An attacker could impersonate a legitimate customer to place fraudulent orders or access their order history.

threats.title: Staff Account Spoofing
threats.description: T-002: An attacker could impersonate staff to manipulate order statuses, access sales reports, or modify menu items and application configurations.

threats.title: Web Application Server Spoofing
threats.description: T-003: An attacker might set up a fraudulent web server to phish user credentials or intercept sensitive data.

data.name: Web Application Server
data.description: This authenticates and authorizes the Barista before querying order data. Validates submitted status updates before updating the MongoDB order record.

threats.title: Customer Account Spoofing
threats.description: T-001: An attacker could impersonate a legitimate customer to place fraudulent orders or access their order history.

threats.title: Staff Account Spoofing
threats.description: T-002: An attacker could impersonate staff to manipulate order statuses, access sales reports, or modify menu items and application configurations.

threats.title: Web Application Server Spoofing
threats.description: T-003: An attacker might set up a fraudulent web server to phish user credentials or intercept sensitive data.

threats.title: Order Data Tampering
threats.description: T-004: An attacker could modify order details (e.g., items, quantities, prices, status) in transit or at rest.

threats.title: Menu Data Tampering
threats.description: T-005: An attacker could alter menu item data (e.g., prices or descriptions) before it is stored in the database.

threats.title: Sales Report Tampering
threats.description: T-006: Unauthorized individuals could alter sales data in the MongoDB Database, leading to falsified reports.

threats.title: Application Code/Configuration Tampering
threats.description: T-007: Malicious modification of the application’s source code, server configurations, or environment variables could introduce backdoors or disable security features.

threats.title: Fraudulent Order Repudiation
threats.description: T-008: A customer could deny placing an order if insufficient logging and non-repudiation controls are in place.

threats.title: Staff Action Repudiation
threats.description: T-009: Staff members (Barista, Manager, Administrator) could deny performing actions if audit logs are insufficient, not immutable, or can be tampered with.

threats.title: Customer PII Disclosure
threats.description: T-010: Unauthorized access to customer names, contact details, delivery addresses, and order history.

threats.title: Staff Credential Disclosure
threats.description: T-011: Exposure of usernames, passwords, or session tokens for staff members due to insecure storage or unencrypted transmission.

threats.title: Application Code and Configuration Disclosure
threats.description: T-012: Exposure of source code, server configurations, environment variables, or API keys.

threats.title: Sales Data Disclosure
threats.description: T-013: Unauthorized access to sales reports or underlying aggregated sales data.

threats.title: Web Application Server DoS
threats.description: T-014: An attacker could flood the Web Application Server with excessive requests, making it unavailable.

threats.title: MongoDB Database DoS
threats.description: T-015: Malicious or poorly optimized queries could overload the database, making it unresponsive.

threats.title: Customer to Staff Privilege Escalation
threats.description: T-016: A customer could exploit a vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to Barista, Manager, or Administrator functionalities.

threats.title: Barista/Manager to Administrator Privilege Escalation
threats.description: T-017: A Barista or Manager could exploit a vulnerability to gain Administrator privileges.

threats.title: Horizontal Privilege Escalation
threats.description: T-018: Gaining unauthorized access to another user’s account within the same privilege level.

data.name: MongoDB Database
data.description: This stores order records, returns pending order data, and receives validated order-status updates from the Web Application Server.
